summary: Depth on NSE cash: the MarketFeedV3 frame alone reaches no Depth subscriber; each MarketDepthService frame then gives the book with the latest quote, a full five-level book replaces it, and an empty book clears it.

notes: FEED and DEPTH are the web test's frames; DEPTH5 is DEPTH with five levels a side and new totals, DEPTH_EMPTY with no levels and zero totals (worked here).

deviations.reason: The 5paisa web adapter passes 5paisa's JSON number on as it came, so a whole price (the web test's OpenRate 445) goes out as an integer (445) where the desktop sends a float (445.0). Same value, another JSON type: follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker number types (5paisa: a price keeps the type of the frame's value).

The desktop pads each side of 5paisa's book to five levels with zero levels (FivepaisaFeed depth_book, v.resize(5, ..)), so a book of one bid and one ask, or an empty book, goes out as five levels a side; the web sends the levels 5paisa sent (_extract_depth_data), and rules.md says no padded book. Desktop defect.

The desktop sends price_change on an equity or a future (ltp less the previous close: feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends ChgPcnt as percent_change only, which the desktop sends too. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.

The desktop sends price_change_percent (5paisa's ChgPcnt) on an equity or a future beside percent_change (feed/dialect/names.rs gives 5paisa instrument_change); the 5paisa web adapter sends percent_change only. Follows the web adapter in Phase B: 5paisa's dialect entry without instrument_change.

The desktop sends 5paisa's best bid and ask in Depth too, from the latest quote: feed/dialect/names.rs sends a web key from the mode the web adapter first sends it in (Quote) and every mode above it, so a script never meets a KeyError on the richer frame; the 5paisa web adapter's Depth dict has no bid or ask. Pending the lead's approval of that rule.
